name: Elena Rodriguez Garcia
bio:
Elena's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for rally racing, sparked by watching her father meticulously prepare his car for local competitions. Though she lacked mechanical aptitude, her organizational skills quickly became apparent as she helped coordinate logistics for his team. This passion led her to pursue a degree in Business Administration, focusing on supply chain management.

After graduating, Elena joined a small touring car team, steadily climbing the ranks to oversee their entire logistics operation. Her meticulous planning and proactive problem-solving skills ensured seamless race weekends, even under pressure. She is known for her calm demeanor and ability to navigate complex logistical challenges with efficiency and precision.

At Tickford Racing, Elena brings her extensive experience to bear, ensuring that every component, tool, and team member arrives at the track on time and ready to perform. Her dedication to detail and her unwavering commitment to supporting the team's success make her an invaluable asset.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, layered with a slight wave.
physical.description: Elena is of average height, with a warm smile that often crinkles the corners of her eyes.

quirks: Always carries a meticulously organized planner with color-coded entries.
Insists on having a perfectly aligned desk before starting any task.
Secretly enjoys listening to classical music through her headphones during downtime.
